source: Lü et al. 2014, Nature Communications 5, Fig. 5 (the cladogram, lower part): strict consensus of the two MPTs, long-snouted tyrannosauroids; rectangular ladder, root left, Bremer/bootstrap pairs at nodes, two node dots with arrows to clade names, a brace with a skull silhouette for Alioramini. The skull-femur regression plot in the upper part of the figure is excluded. Image: census figure (1818x2380 px), rendered from the PDF's vector figure.
